pearls.purpose: Holds the canonical domain template for a ccash constellation: jurisdictions, regulatory profile, station tree, default risk policies. Operator ccash grains Grapple-claim this pearl's TemplateService cap (capnp TypeID 0xf1e2d3c4b5a69780) to seed their own setup; updates here propagate to all consumers on next request via mtime-aware cache.

offers.name: domain-template
offers.purpose: Read the canonical template — jurisdictions, station tree, default policies.

offers.name: station-template
offers.purpose: Pick a station template (per-jurisdiction) at workspace setup time.

adminOnly.name: Update domain templates
adminOnly.purpose: Owner pushes new YAML; consumers see the change on their next request.

anyMember.name: Read templates
anyMember.purpose: Anyone with a Grapple claim can read.

blockchains.purpose: Release attestation only; this pearl makes no other on-chain calls.

capnp.name: ccash.DomainTemplate@1
capnp.purpose: Read the canonical template — jurisdictions, station tree, default policies.

capnp.name: ccash.StationTemplate@1
capnp.purpose: Pick a station template (per-jurisdiction) at workspace setup time.
